common: normalize curly and typographic quotes to ASCII quotes
normalize Unicode dashes and minus signs to ASCII hyphen-minus
collapse all whitespace runs to one ASCII space and trim outer whitespace
remove thousands separators only when a comma is between ASCII digits
trim terminal ASCII sentence punctuation (. , ; : ! ?) without treating percent as punctuation
numeric: detect explicit candidate and reference units before numeric parsing
accept an explicit candidate unit only when it is compatible with the reference scale or an explicitly embedded reference scale
reject a conflicting or unsupported explicit candidate unit
strip the dollar sign and USD/dollar tokens as numeric formatting
strip commas between digits as thousands separators
strip percent sign or percent/percentage words only after percent-unit compatibility
strip visible billion/million/thousand scale words only after scale-unit compatibility
interpret a number wrapped in parentheses as negative, including an inner explicit minus sign
compare arithmetic values with the frozen numeric tolerance

count_handling.accepted: Exactly one finite non-negative integer after common numeric normalization; explicit scale words are rejected.
count_handling.comparison: candidate integer must equal reference integer exactly

full_semantic_answer_accuracy.arithmetic: Numeric value match under the frozen tolerance; an explicit incompatible unit fails, while omission of the reference scale is compatible.
full_semantic_answer_accuracy.denominator: 506 qualified table-text questions with complete semantic references; the predeclared NOT_MODEL_READY item is excluded before any model output.
full_semantic_answer_accuracy.multi_span: All normalized gold spans must occur in the normalized candidate as word-boundary substrings; order is ignored and extra candidate text is allowed.
full_semantic_answer_accuracy.span: Normalized equality or normalized word-boundary containment in either direction is accepted.
unknown_reasonable_only_if: ambiguity_visible was frozen true before model output because multiple legal interpretations remain from visible evidence
the reference status was frozen as NOT_MODEL_READY before model output and the item is excluded from the primary denominator

executed_screen.status: offline evidence-sufficiency proxy; not model accuracy
